title: TrackState
description: Per-frame, per-hand causal tracking state (Phase 01 contract; produced by tracking, Phase 03). Exactly one TrackState per hand per processed frame, including INVALID/STALE frames. docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.4.

tracker_id.description: Tracker implementation + config id (filter type/params are config, Phase 03).

tip_method.description: Method of the StickObservation consumed this frame (null when none). Carried so every downstream result can be labelled per integrity item I-7.

tip_filtered.description: Filtered tip position, ROI-normalized. Null when status is INVALID or STALE.

axis_angle.description: Stick axis angle in radians, measured from +x towards +y (y-down image frame).

confidence.description: Tracker confidence for this frame (feeds the VALID/DEGRADED decision against c_valid / c_min).

frames_since_valid.description: 0 when this frame is a fresh VALID observation; counts up during DEGRADED/INVALID.

last_valid_t.description: t_capture of the most recent VALID observation; null if none since the last reset.

n.description: Number of past TrackStates currently in the causal history window (<= configured N).

history_ref.description: Metadata about the in-memory causal history window. The window itself is not serialised: it is reconstructible from the stream of TrackState records (Task 01.9). Null after a reset.

reset_reason.description: Set on the frame in which a reset occurred (reset matrix, architecture.md section 6); null otherwise.
